newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp raised to buy.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Timothy Ross said he upgraded AMR Corp to buy from add.
-- Ross said the airline and the pilots seem to be moving towards a settlement. American's pilots could strike if an agreement were not reached by Feb 15.
-- "It appears that despite the extreme posture the two sides have taken, the cost of a strike looks too horrible. That could lead to a settlement," Ross said.
-- said AMR's stock has dropped since the pilots rejected the airline's wage offer in January, making it relatively cheap.
-- said based on historical trends for airline strikes, any job action by the pilots would likely last about four to five days before settlement or government intervention.
-- said if the pilots did strike, AMR's share price would fall by about $2.50 a share for each strike day anticipated. AMR's stock would see a $10-$12 drop on the first day following a strike.
-- American gained 1/4 to 83-1/8 in early morning trading.
